_meta.purpose: Short-lived editorial controls for Featured Now. This file must not contain a frozen replacement list.
_meta.default_behavior: When pins, blocks, and boosts are empty, publish the policy-ranked selection without editorial modification.
_meta.topic_name_rule: Use an exact topic name from public/topics_config.js or an exact family id from featured_topics_policy.json.
_meta.time_rule: All starts_at and expires_at values use RFC 3339 UTC timestamps. Expired controls are ignored.
_meta.audit_rule: Every control requires a reason and editor. Pins and boosts should normally expire within 14 days; blocks within 30 days.
_meta.safety_rule: A pin changes selection priority only. It must not embed or freeze an article, score, PB depth, or source count.
